results.title: CutCat: Skip Mature Content on Netflix in Chrome, Free
results.content:
CutCat is a free Chrome extension that mutes or skips mature content, nudity and gore while you watch Netflix. It works from scenes that other viewers have already marked, so the film keeps playing and you simply do not sit through that part. The extension runs inside the Netflix player you already use in Chrome on a computer, and it is not affiliated with Netflix. Its promise is deliberately narrow: keep watching, skip the scene. CutCat is built for people who want to stay with a series or a film but would rather not sit through nudity, gore, strong language, kissing or credits, and who want to decide for themselves which of those categories count. The problem it addresses is a familiar one for anyone watching a title that mixes a story they want with material they do not. A marked scene [...] as a small, single-purpose tool that does one job in the Netflix player and then stays out of the way. It skips or mutes marked scenes, lets the viewer choose which categories apply, keeps settings in the browser, records nothing about what is watched, and costs nothing. The value proposition is the sentence the site opens with: keep watching, skip the scene. Put it on, then forget it is there. [...] •Scene skipping: when playback reaches a stretch that viewers have marked, CutCat jumps the whole stretch rather than blurring or fast-forwarding it. The story continues either side of the gap and the part in between is never shown. The site applies this to mature content, nudity, violence and gore, kissing and credits, so a marked scene is gone before it starts.
 •Frame-measured muting: for marked lines, only the line is silenced and the sound comes straight back. The mute is measured to the frame, so the scene around the line is not lost. This lets a viewer keep the picture, the performances and the surrounding dialogue while removing a word or a line they would rather not hear.

# Skip mature content, nudity and gore on Netflix

Keep watching. Skip the scene.

CutCat mutes or skips mature content, nudity and gore while you watch Netflix, using scenes marked by viewers who got there first. The film keeps playing. You just do not sit through that part.

Add to Chrome See what is covered

Free. No ads. Works inside the Netflix player you already use.

~1500 scenes already marked across ~150 titles, and counting.

00:00:00 playing

### A marked scene is gone before it starts

Playback jumps the whole stretch. You see the story either side of it and never the part in between.

### A word is muted, then the sound comes straight back

Only the line is silenced, measured to the frame, so you do not lose the scene around it. [...] ### You decide what counts

Switch whole categories on or off. Mute strong language and skip nothing else, if that is what you want.

## What is covered so far

~1500 scenes marked across ~150 titles, on 2,500 films and episodes.

44 scenes marked [...] What happens on a film nobody has marked?

It plays as normal. CutCat only acts on scenes viewers have marked, so check the list above for what is covered. The list grows as viewers mark more.

  Does it change or cut the film?

No. Nothing is downloaded or altered. When playback reaches a marked stretch it jumps past it, or the sound drops for a marked line and comes straight back.

  Does it record what I watch?

No. It never records what you watch, and your category settings stay in your browser. The privacy policy lists exactly what is and is not collected.

  Is it free?

Yes. It is free and has no ads.
